mapper.select: SELECT FROM withdrawal_order WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM withdrawal_order WHERE request_key=#{requestKey} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM withdrawal_order WHERE mer_order_no=#{merOrderNo} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM withdrawal_order WHERE draw_jnl=#{drawJnl} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE withdrawal_order SET status='PROCESSING', draw_jnl=#{drawJnl}, channel_state='DRAW.ACCEPTED', submit_response_sha256=#{submitResponseSha256}, sent_at=#{now}, version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status='CREATED'

UPDATE withdrawal_order SET status='PROCESSING', channel_state=#{channelState}, sent_at=COALESCE(sent_at, #{now}), version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status='CREATED'

UPDATE withdrawal_order SET status='PROCESSING', draw_jnl=COALESCE(draw_jnl, #{drawJnl}), channel_state=#{channelState}, fee_amount=COALESCE(#{feeAmount}, fee_amount), net_amount=COALESCE(#{netAmount}, net_amount), settle_no=COALESCE(#{settleNo}, settle_no), version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status IN ('CREATED','PROCESSING')

UPDATE withdrawal_order SET status='SUCCEEDED', draw_jnl=COALESCE(draw_jnl, #{drawJnl}), channel_state=#{channelState}, fee_amount=#{feeAmount}, net_amount=#{netAmount}, settle_no=COALESCE(#{settleNo}, settle_no), fail_reason=NULL, terminal_receipt_sha256=#{terminalReceiptSha256}, result_event_id=#{resultEventId}, finished_at=#{finishedAt}, version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status IN ('CREATED','PROCESSING')

UPDATE withdrawal_order SET status='FAILED', draw_jnl=COALESCE(draw_jnl, #{drawJnl}), channel_state=#{channelState}, fail_reason=#{failReason}, terminal_receipt_sha256=#{terminalReceiptSha256}, result_event_id=#{resultEventId}, finished_at=#{finishedAt}, version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status IN ('CREATED','PROCESSING')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO withdrawal_receipt( id,withdrawal_id,receipt_sha256,receipt_source,channel_response_sha256, draw_jnl,draw_state,draw_amount,fee_amount,memo,complete_time,received_at) VALUES( #{id},#{withdrawalId},#{receiptSha256},#{receiptSource},#{channelResponseSha256}, #{drawJnl},#{drawState},#{drawAmount},#{feeAmount},#{memo},#{completeTime},#{receivedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS pending_count, COALESCE(SUM(merchant_share), 0.00) AS pending_amount FROM settlement_order WHERE merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND status IN ('PENDING_TRIGGER','WAITING','ON_HOLD','SPLITTING','SPLIT_FAILED')
